title: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I
question: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I want the full name of each driver.

prediction.sql:
WITH driver_pts AS (
  SELECT r.year, ds.driver_id, SUM(ds.points) AS total_points
  FROM driver_standings ds
  JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
  GROUP BY r.year, ds.driver_id
),
top_driver AS (
  SELECT year, driver_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points DESC, driver_id) AS rn
  FROM driver_pts
),
constructor_pts AS (
  SELECT r.year, cs.constructor_id, SUM(cs.points) AS total_points
  FROM constructor_standings cs
  JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
  GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
),
top_constructor AS (
  SELECT year, constructor_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points DESC, constructor_id) AS rn
  FROM constructor_pts
)
SELECT td.year,
       d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_full_name,
       c.name AS constructor_name
FROM top_driver td
JOIN drivers d ON td.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN top_constructor tc ON tc.year = td.year AND tc.rn = 1
JOIN constructors c ON tc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE td.rn = 1
ORDER BY td.year

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
WITH driver_top AS (
  SELECT r.year, ds.driver_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY ds.points DESC) AS rn
  FROM driver_standings ds
  JOIN races r ON r.race_id = ds.race_id
  WHERE r.round = (SELECT MAX(r2.round) FROM races r2 WHERE r2.year = r.year)
),
constructor_top AS (
  SELECT r.year, cs.constructor_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY cs.points DESC) AS rn
  FROM constructor_standings cs
  JOIN races r ON r.race_id = cs.race_id
  WHERE r.round = (SELECT MAX(r2.round) FROM races r2 WHERE r2.year = r.year)
)
SELECT dt.year,
       d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_full_name,
       c.name AS constructor_name
FROM driver_top dt
JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id = dt.driver_id
JOIN constructor_top ct ON ct.year = dt.year
JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id = ct.constructor_id
WHERE dt.rn = 1 AND ct.rn = 1
ORDER BY dt.year;
